hypothesis: Wall, opening, and junction errors require global multi-scale routing and a typed wall-junction-room-boundary opening host contract in addition to local refinement.

budget.extension_rule: Extend only when wall precision and F1 or junction topology continue improving with non-collapsed route entropy.

controls: typed_v2 static route head at legacy width
typed_v2 equal-parameter local convolution at width 64
typed_v2 full global route at width 64
full route with static top-k budget
full route without room/wall multi-scale memory

gate.screen: Wall precision and F1 improve jointly or one improves without the other regressing; opening and junction signals do not regress.
gate.promotion: The full route beats equal-parameter local convolution and static-budget MIta on calibration and disjoint holdout.
gate.confirmation: At least 4/5 seeds preserve direction; paired 95% CI excludes zero.

claim_boundary: Architecture and budget contract only; no structure metric claim before matched runs.
